name: 馬尚智
objective:
I. Introduction
II. Linear block codes
III. Cyclic codes
IV. Convolutional codes
V. Coded modulation
schedule:
I. Introduction (1st wk)
II. Linear block codes (2nd wk ~ 5th wk)
1. Maximum likelihood decoding
2. Standard array
3. Syndrome decoding
4. Hamming codes
5. Reed-Muller codes
III. Cyclic codes (6th wk ~ 8th wk)
1. Introduction to algebra
2. Encoding
3. Error-trapping decoding
4. BCH codes
Mid-Term Exam 9th wk
IV. Convolutional codes (10th wk ~ 13th wk)
1. Structural properties
2. Distance properties
3. The Viterbi algorithm
V. Coded modulation (14th wk ~ 15th wk)
1. Set partitioning
2. Block coded modulation
3. Multistage decoding
4. Trellis coded modulaion
Final Exam 16th wk
scorePolicy:
Mid-Term Exam 40 %
Final Exam 40 %
Flexible Learning 20 %
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】



Error Control Coding, 2nd edition, Shu Lin and Daniel J. Costello, Jr.
